reviewed_sources.name: Generated-project distribution contract
reviewed_sources.notes: Every extracted operating-loop module must be distributed with the public entry.
reviewed_sources.lifecycle_reason: Initialization is where the source module graph becomes a generated-project runtime graph.
reviewed_sources.expected_behavior: Manifest validation and generated-project parity prove all eight internal modules are installed.
reviewed_sources.negative_or_reverse_behavior: Omitting any module or copy rule must fail manifest closure or generated-project verification.

reviewed_sources.name: Source command orchestration
reviewed_sources.notes: This module owns the extracted subprocess sequence without changing its public contract.
reviewed_sources.lifecycle_reason: Subprocess ordering determines which workflow facts are available to later decision and presentation stages.
reviewed_sources.expected_behavior: The same source commands run in the same order and preserve their stdout, stderr, and exit-code interpretation.
reviewed_sources.negative_or_reverse_behavior: A source failure remains fail-closed and cannot be hidden by the module boundary.

reviewed_sources.name: Public operating-loop entry
reviewed_sources.processing_path_name: Argument parsing, orchestration, decision, and rendering
reviewed_sources.notes: The original public path remains the only supported entry.
reviewed_sources.lifecycle_reason: All public modes and arguments enter the workflow through this file.
reviewed_sources.expected_behavior: Existing arguments, output section order, decision state, and exit codes remain unchanged.
reviewed_sources.negative_or_reverse_behavior: Unknown modes and downstream failures retain the prior non-zero behavior and diagnostic ordering.

reviewed_sources.name: Modular-source self-check consumption
reviewed_sources.notes: Self-checks must inspect the complete source graph after a thin-entry refactor.
reviewed_sources.lifecycle_reason: Architecture validation is the fail-closed eligibility boundary before completion.
reviewed_sources.expected_behavior: Legacy-marker and modularity checks inspect the public entry and every internal module.
reviewed_sources.negative_or_reverse_behavior: Moving a forbidden marker into an extracted module must still fail the self-check.

reviewed_sources.name: Structural modularity characterization
reviewed_sources.processing_path_name: Size, import, dependency, manifest, and distribution assertions
reviewed_sources.notes: This is test evidence, not a production-runtime claim.
reviewed_sources.lifecycle_reason: The test observes the structural contract and prevents the monolith from silently returning.
reviewed_sources.expected_behavior: The entry stays at or below 380 lines, modules stay at or below 500 lines, and the dependency graph remains explicit and distributed.
reviewed_sources.negative_or_reverse_behavior: Oversized modules, missing exports, dependency cycles, or missing distribution entries fail deterministically.
